# BotWave

> Free WhatsApp bot automation platform. 50+ commands, AI chat, sticker maker, media downloads, group management, games, anti-spam — no coding needed.

BotWave is a no-code WhatsApp bot platform that lets anyone automate their WhatsApp with powerful features. Connect your WhatsApp number by scanning a QR code and get instant access to 50+ bot commands.

## Key Features

- **Sticker Maker**: Convert any image or video into WhatsApp stickers instantly
- **AI Chat**: Intelligent AI-powered replies using Google Gemini
- **Media Downloader**: Download YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels without watermarks
- **Group Management**: Welcome messages, anti-spam, polls, leaderboards
- **Mini Games**: Trivia, Hangman, Word Chain, Number Guess
- **Auto-Reply**: Custom automated responses for when you're offline
- **Anti-Ban Protection**: Human-like delays, session warmup, rate limiting
- **Scheduled Messages**: Send messages at specific times
- **Custom Commands**: Create your own bot commands

## Who Uses BotWave

- WhatsApp group admins managing communities
- Small businesses automating customer support
- Campus groups and student communities in Nigeria and Africa
- Content creators engaging their audience
- Anyone who wants WhatsApp automation without coding

## Comparison with Other Platforms

- **vs Telegram Bots**: BotWave brings Telegram-level bot features to WhatsApp — where your audience already is in Africa
- **vs Twitter/X Bots**: BotWave focuses on WhatsApp, the dominant messaging platform in Nigeria and across Africa
- **vs Paid Bot Platforms ($20-50/mo)**: BotWave is free with a generous free tier. Paid plans start at just NGN 500/month
- **vs Evolution API**: BotWave is built on Evolution API but adds a no-code web dashboard — no server setup or coding needed
- **vs Baileys Library**: BotWave wraps Baileys in a user-friendly platform — all the power, none of the complexity

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Evolution API
- Self-hosted on Contabo VPS with Docker
- Anti-ban system with session warmup, typing delays, message variation
- Real-time dashboard for monitoring and configuration
- RESTful API for advanced integrations

## Pricing

- **Free**: 300 messages/month, 10 AI queries/day, 1 WhatsApp session
- **Starter (NGN 500/mo)**: 3,000 messages, 50 AI queries, 2 sessions
- **Standard (NGN 2,000/mo)**: Unlimited messages, 200 AI queries, 5 sessions
- **Boss (NGN 5,000/mo)**: Unlimited everything, priority support, API access
